scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client; npm run lint --workspace=server; npm run lint --workspace=shared
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=client; npm run lint:fix --workspace=server; npm run lint:fix --workspace=shared
scripts.tsc: npm run tsc --workspace=shared && npm run tsc --workspace=server && npm run tsc --workspace=client
scripts.tsc:watch: npm run tsc:watch --workspace=shared & npm run tsc:watch --workspace=server & npm run tsc:watch --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run tsc && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=shared
